work_item: Ensure current-format saved AskPreviousRelation results cannot bypass ExplainPrevious Recovery validation when their sealed input lookup is missing or misbound
permission_scope: Continuing user authorization to implement in MINIDORA-BETA and retain work in its repository; local source change, focused checks, direct main commit/fast-forward push, and existing backup-reference rotation only.

runtime.managed_cloud_environment: Platform reported the existing /workspace checkout ready; pinned Rust/Cargo 1.99.1 binaries were invoked via their explicit toolchain path; Git CLI fetch/ls-remote succeeded; no external provider was used.
runtime.remote_access: Repository reads and writes use Git CLI; no GitHub connector API, other provider, deployment or external action was used.

implementation.route: The normal Japanese Engine path commits a premise, a direct explicit Ask, a typed AskPreviousRelation result and ExplainPrevious to a permissioned fixture target. After Engine reopen, the valid saved result passes Recovery inspect.
implementation.root_cause: verify_previous_relation_context allowed missing prior input bundles to fall through to the revision-less legacy fallback. A current saved AskPreviousRelation ResultRecord with actor_memory_revision present could therefore lose its input_id in a cloned CaseRevision and Recovery would still return Ok.
implementation.guard: Before typed-result dispatch, a loaded prior input must have identity(request)==previous.id. If lookup is absent and the saved ResultRecord has actor_memory_revision, Recovery returns RECOVERY_CONTEXT_PROOF_CHANGED. Results without actor_memory_revision retain the pre-existing missing-input fallback; this legacy branch was not independently exercised by B87.
implementation.negative_case: Only the prior AskPreviousRelation ResultRecord input_id changes to an unbound ID in a cloned CaseRevision. The result id, map key, COMMIT lifecycle and input_version stay unchanged. Recovery stops with RECOVERY_CONTEXT_PROOF_CHANGED; persisted latest revision and output bytes remain unchanged.
implementation.current_head_index: The prior-result input binding check runs before the existing saved prior-relation proof/current-head validation; no index or proof algorithm changed.
implementation.retained_revision_replay: Valid Engine reopen inspect passes before the clone-only mutation; no persistent Store record is edited.
preserved_contracts: Current-format prior results with an actor-memory revision require their sealed input identity for Recovery.
When a prior input bundle exists, its request identity must equal the ResultRecord.id.
Revision-less legacy records keep the previous optional-input path.
No schema/API/dependency/manifest/lockfile change; production change is confined to the existing Recovery consumer.
implementation.change_type: One existing Recovery identity guard plus one Engine-library regression test.
implementation.runtime_verification_scope: One saved AskPreviousRelation -> ExplainPrevious Recovery route; malformed prior result exists only in a cloned CaseRevision, not in persistent Store.
